articles.title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
articles.description: Higgsfield, founded by former Snap exec Alex Mashrabov, lets users create AI images and videos.

articles.title: Saylor says share buyback isn’t priority as Strategy builds $4.8 billion cash reserve
articles.description: Strategy is prioritizing STRC, cash reserves, and its credit business over stock buybacks, Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said Monday.

articles.title: Binance to plan UK relaunch with FCA license application: Report
articles.description: Binance’s UK arm has been barred from offering regulated activities in the country since June 2021, but the company will reportedly move to secure licensing under new crypto rules.

articles.title: Sound-powered fire protection startup gets $15M to snuff out fires before they turn catastrophic
articles.description: Sonic Fire Protection raised its new funding to help get its sound-powered fire protection system into everything from commercial kitchens to apartment buildings.

articles.title: CFTC seeks public input on AI compute futures contracts as CME eyes October launch
articles.description: The regulatory review could shape an emerging market that lets companies and investors trade and hedge the cost of increasingly scarce AI computing power.

articles.title: Feedly attributes weeklong slowdown to bug, not its AI pivot
articles.description: Feedly says a bug is behind the performance issues that have made its web app nearly "unusable" for some users, while complaints about its mobile apps and customer support are adding to frustrations.

articles.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
articles.description: Sheldon Lee said a Chinese-language X account making the claims was hacked. Users want wallets, assets and liabilities disclosed.

articles.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
articles.description: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.description: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.description: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
articles.description: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

articles.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized losses
articles.description: Tom Lee’s Ethereum treasury company keeps buying the second-biggest crypto through the downturn, while more than 5 million staked ETH is projected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.

articles.title: Compound bets $52 million, new leadership team in switch to institutional focus
articles.description: The protocol pioneered decentralized finance lending, but assets locked have tumbled from a peak five years ago. Now it's looking to attract institutions after retail traders lost interest.

articles.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
articles.description: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.

articles.title: Terra Industries closes $52M seed round to build defense infrastructure for the Global South
articles.description: African defense tech company Terra Industries announced an additional $18 million in funding, bringing its seed round to $52 million.

articles.title: WordPress.com targets the next generation of web creators with a free student plan
articles.description: WordPress.com Education lets teachers offer their students free domains, plug-in support, and professional website-building tools.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
articles.description: The Treasury proposal would establish some of the core definitions and jurisdictions in the law Congress completed last year.

articles.title: The Coldcard hack proves reputation is not a security model
articles.description: A community built on verification spent five years outsourcing its judgment to one man, writes Foundation CEO Zach Herbert.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine now owns 4.8% of Ethereum supply after latest ETH purchase
articles.description: The crypto treasury company bought another 9,926 ETH last week, extending a buying streak that began in June 2025.

articles.title: How a bug in Coldcard’s code went unnoticed for years, leading to $100 million in hacked funds
articles.description: Crypto’s favorite maxim, “don’t trust, verify” wasn’t followed in the case of Coldcard’s code.
